business.description: Trigyn Technologies Limited is a company listed on BSE and NSE with registered office at 27, SDF-1, SEEPZ, Andheri (East), Mumbai 400 096, India. It has subsidiaries in the US (Trigyn Technologies Inc.) and Switzerland (Trigyn Technologies Schweiz GMBH under liquidation).

products.name: DIKSHA 2.0
products.note: Flagship platform with user base exceeding 170 million, available in 22 scheduled Indian languages, featuring GenAI-powered learning features including AskDIKSHA, AI-generated chapter summaries, practice questions, language translation, audio podcasts, interactive voice features, and self-assessment tools

products.name: Enterprise Digitalization and Process Intelligence
products.note: Solutions focused on digital workflows, process automation, intelligent decision-making, and operational efficiency.

products.name: Cloud Services and AIOps
products.note: Cloud consulting, migration, modernization, and optimization services supported by automation, monitoring and analytics capabilities.

products.name: Data Platforms, Analytics and MLOps
products.note: Data engineering, enterprise data platforms, advanced analytics and machine learning solutions, including scalable deployment and governance of AI/ML models.

products.name: Smart City and IoT Solutions
products.note: Technology platforms integrating IoT, analytics, computer vision and AI-enabled capabilities to support urban mobility, public safety, energy management and citizen services.

products.name: Healthcare and Medicaid Technology Services
products.note: Technology solutions supporting Medicaid modernization, public health platforms, compliance, analytics, and digital engagement.

products.name: Security and Risk Management
products.note: Cybersecurity and risk management services encompassing threat monitoring, security automation, intelligence, and related technology solutions.

products.name: Staffing and Consulting Services

products.name: Digital Learning and Knowledge Platforms

risks: business, operational, financial, legal, regulatory and strategic risks

Global Economic and Geopolitical Volatility: Economic slowdowns, political instability, and currency fluctuations may impact project budgets and procurement cycles, particularly in public sector engagements.
Talent Availability and Rising Costs: The industry faces persistent shortages in specialized AI, cloud, and cybersecurity skills.
Technology Disruption: The rapid evolution of AI, automation, and cloud technologies requires ongoing investment in innovation and delivery capabilities.
Cybersecurity and Data Privacy Risks: Expanding regulatory frameworks, including global data protection laws and AI governance standards, require heightened vigilance.
Macroeconomic and Geopolitical Uncertainty: Global economic slowdowns and geopolitical events can impact client budgets and delay large-scale initiatives, particularly in the public sector.
Competitive Market Dynamics: Intense competition from both large technology providers and agile startups requires continuous differentiation through innovation and domain expertise.
Regulatory and Compliance Challenges: Operating across multiple regions necessitates strict adherence to data privacy, AI ethics, and evolving security regulations.

outlook.statement: Trigyn enters FY2026-2027 with a strengthened foundation for growth, a diversified client base, and a clear roadmap for scaling innovation to meet evolving client and market needs.
The Company remains focused on delivering sustainable growth in FY2026-2027 and beyond.
Global IT spending continues to grow, with significant investments being directed toward AI-driven automation, modernization of legacy platforms, and secure, cloud-native infrastructure.

The Company remains focused on maintaining financial and operational discipline while pursuing opportunities aligned with its strategic priorities, strengthening capabilities, enhancing execution, and building a resilient platform to support future growth.

The Board and management continue to drive investments in Centers of Excellence, reusable AI accelerators, and global delivery optimization to deliver higher-value solutions at scale in AI, cloud modernization, cybersecurity, and digital government platforms.
Trigyn remains focused on stabilizing its leadership structure and rebuilding momentum in key markets, supported by a diversified portfolio and an innovation-driven service model.
Management believes two loss-making Indian subsidiaries will be able to finance operations and meet commitments from internal cash generation and financial support from holding company
Voluntary liquidation proceedings commenced for wholly-owned foreign subsidiary Trigyn Technologies Schweiz GmbH (TTS) as of July 16, 2024; process ongoing as at March 31, 2026
